body.name: closed joint-sign sector
body.construction: For \(\sigma=(\sigma_b,\sigma_c)\in\{-1,+1\}^2\), \(H_{\sigma}=\{(d,q)\in[0,1]\times\mathbb R:\sigma_bA_{12}(d,q;\Sigma)\ge\eta,\ \sigma_cA_{21}(d,q;\Sigma)\ge\eta\}\), and \(J_{\sigma}\) is the assertion that some \((d,q)\in H_{\sigma}\) has \(0<d<1\).
